{{Quote|We worship the Left-Handed God, the Soulworm, the Lady with the Locust Heart. We worship ''evil'', my handsome child.|Suzal|<ref name="TPE">{{StoryCite|story=The Pandora Effect|book=The Empire Strikes Back Monthly 151}}</ref>}}
The '''Lady with the Locust Heart''' was an evil deity worshiped by the cult of the [[Five]], alongside other deities such as the [[Left-Handed God]] and the [[Soulworm]]. [[Suzal]] mentioned the Lady with the Locust Heart to [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] while explaining the cult's beliefs.<ref name="TPE" />
